lines.author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji (M5)
lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਜੋ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਬਲਨਾ ਸਰਪ ਜੈਸੇ ਅਰਜਾਰੀ ॥
lines.translit: bin simaran jo jeevan balanaa sarap jaise arajaaree
lines.en: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, life is like a burning fire, even if one lives long, like a snake.

lines.author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji (M5)
lines.gurmukhi: ਨਵ ਖੰਡਨ ਕੋ ਰਾਜੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਅੰਤਿ ਚਲੈਗੋ ਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.translit: nav khandan ko raaj kamaavai ant chalaigo haaree
lines.en: One may rule over the nine regions of the earth, but in the end, he shall have to depart, losing the game of life. ||1||

lines.author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji (M5)
lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਗੁਣ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਗਾਏ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
lines.translit: gun nidhaan gun tin hee gaae jaa kau kirapaa dhaaree
lines.en: He alone sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the treasure of virtue, upon whom the Lord showers His Grace.

lines.author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji (M5)
lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਧੰਨੁ ਉਸੁ ਜਨਮਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੨॥੨॥
lines.translit: so sukheeaa dhann us janamaa naanak tis balihaaree
lines.en: He is at peace, and his birth is blessed; Nanak is a sacrifice to him. ||2||2||

lines.author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji (M5)
lines.gurmukhi: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਚਉਪਦੇ
lines.translit: todee mahalaa ghar chaupade
lines.en: Todee, Fifth Mehl, Second House, Chau-Padhay:

lines.author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji (M5)
lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.translit: ik oankaar satigur prasaad
lines.en: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji (M5)
lines.gurmukhi: ਧਾਇਓ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਇਓ ॥
lines.translit: dhaaio re man dah dis dhaaio
lines.en: The mind wanders, wandering in the ten directions.

lines.author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji (M5)
lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਗਨ ਸੁਆਦਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਤਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਓ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.translit: maaiaa magan suaad lobh mohio tin prabh aap bhulaaio
lines.en: It is intoxicated by Maya, enticed by the taste of greed. God Himself has deluded it. ||Pause||

lines.author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji (M5)
lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਇਕੁ ਮੁਹਤੁ ਨ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਇਓ ॥
lines.translit: har kathaa har jas saadhasangat siu ik muhat na ih man laaio
lines.en: He does not focus his mind, even for a moment, on the Lord's sermon, or the Lord's Praises, or the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

lines.author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji (M5)
lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਗਸਿਓ ਪੇਖਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਕੋ ਪਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਜੋਹਨਿ ਜਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
lines.translit: bigasio pekh rang kasumbh ko par grih johan jaaio
lines.en: He is excited, gazing on the transitory color of the safflower, and looking at other men's wives. ||1||

lines.author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji (M5)
lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਕੀਨੋ ਨਹ ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਨਾਇਓ ॥
lines.translit: charan kamal siu bhaau na keeno nah sat purakh manaaio
lines.en: He does not love the Lord's lotus feet, and he does not please the True Lord.

lines.author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji (M5)
lines.gurmukhi: ਧਾਵਤ ਕਉ ਧਾਵਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤੀ ਜਿਉ ਤੇਲੀ ਬਲਦੁ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
lines.translit: dhaavat kau dhaavah bah bhaatee jiu telee balad bhramaaio
lines.en: He runs around chasing the fleeting objects of the world, in all directions, like the ox around the oil press. ||2||

lines.author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji (M5)
lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਨ ਕੀਓ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗਾਇਓ ॥
lines.translit: naam daan isanaan na keeo ik nimakh na keerat gaaio
lines.en: He does not practice the Naam, the Name of the Lord; nor does he practice charity or inner cleansing.

lines.author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji (M5)
lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਾ ਝੂਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਮਨੁ ਤੋਖਿਓ ਨਹ ਬੂਝਿਓ ਅਪਨਾਇਓ ॥੩॥
lines.translit: naanaa jhooth laai man tokhio nah boojhio apanaaio
lines.en: He does not sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, even for an instant. Clinging to his many falsehoods, he does not please his own mind, and he does not understand his own self. ||3||

lines.author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji (M5)
lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਕੀਏ ਨਹੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਧਿਆਇਓ ॥
lines.translit: paraupakaar na kabahoo kee nahee satigur sev dhiaaio
lines.en: He never does good deeds for others; he does not serve or meditate on the True Guru.

lines.author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji (M5)
lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਰਚਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੋਸਟਿ ਮਤਵਾਰੋ ਮਦ ਮਾਇਓ ॥੪॥
lines.translit: panch doot rach sangat gosat matavaaro mad maaio
lines.en: He is entangled in the company and the advice of the five demons, intoxicated by the wine of Maya. ||4||

lines.author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji (M5)
lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਇਓ ॥
lines.translit: karau benatee saadhasangat har bhagat vachhal sun aaio
lines.en: I offer my prayer in the Saadh Sangat; hearing that the Lord is the Lover of His devotees, I have come.

lines.author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji (M5)
lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਾਗਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਛੈ ਰਾਖੁ ਲਾਜ ਅਪੁਨਾਇਓ ॥੫॥੧॥੩॥
lines.translit: naanak bhaag pario har paachhai raakh laaj apunaaio
lines.en: Nanak runs after the Lord, and pleads, "Protect my honor, Lord, and make me Your own." ||5||1||3||

lines.author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji (M5)
lines.gurmukhi: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.translit: todee mahalaa
lines.en: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

lines.author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji (M5)
lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੁਖੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਆਇਆ ॥
lines.translit: maanukh bin boojhe birathaa aaiaa
lines.en: Without understanding, his coming into the world is useless.

lines.author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji (M5)
lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਸਾਜ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਜਿਉ ਮਿਰਤਕੁ ਓਢਾਇਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.translit: anik saaj seegaar bah karataa jiu miratak odhaaiaa
lines.en: He puts on various ornaments and many decorations, but it is like dressing a corpse. ||Pause||

lines.author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji (M5)
lines.gurmukhi: ਧਾਇ ਧਾਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਨ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਕਰੀ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.translit: dhaai dhaai kripan sram keeno ikatr karee hai maaiaa
lines.en: With great effort and exertion, the miser works to gather in the riches of Maya.

lines.author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji (M5)
lines.gurmukhi: ਦਾਨੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਸੰਤਨ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਿਤ ਹੀ ਕਾਜਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.translit: daan punn nahee santan sevaa kit hee kaaj na aaiaa
lines.en: He does not give anything in charity or generosity, and he does not serve the Saints; his wealth does not do him any good at all. ||1||

lines.author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji (M5)
lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਆਭਰਣ ਸਵਾਰੀ ਸੇਜਾ ਕਾਮਨਿ ਥਾਟੁ ਬਨਾਇਆ ॥
lines.translit: kar aabharan savaaree sejaa kaaman thaat banaaiaa
lines.en: The soul-bride puts on her ornaments, embellishes her bed, and fashions decorations.

lines.author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji (M5)
lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਭਰਤੇ ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.translit: sang na paaio apune bharate pekh pekh dukh paaiaa
lines.en: But if she does not obtain the company of her Husband Lord, the sight of these decorations only brings her pain. ||2||

lines.author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji (M5)
lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰੋ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਮਜੂਰੀ ਕਰਤਾ ਤੁਹੁ ਮੂਸਲਹਿ ਛਰਾਇਆ ॥
lines.translit: saaro dinas majooree karataa tuh moosalah chharaaiaa
lines.en: The man works all day long, threshing the husks with the pestle.

lines.author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji (M5)
lines.gurmukhi: ਖੇਦੁ ਭਇਓ ਬੇਗਾਰੀ ਨਿਆਈ ਘਰ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੩॥
lines.translit: khed bhaio begaaree niaaee ghar kai kaam na aaiaa
lines.en: He is depressed, like a forced laborer, and so he is of no use to his own home. ||3||

lines.author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji (M5)
lines.gurmukhi: ਭਇਓ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
lines.translit: bhaio anugrah jaa kau prabh ko tis hiradai naam vasaaiaa
lines.en: But when God shows His Mercy and Grace, He implants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within the heart.

lines.author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji (M5)
lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਰਿਅਉ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੨॥੪॥
lines.translit: saadhasangat kai paachhai pariau jan naanak har ras paaiaa
lines.en: Search the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, and find the sublime essence of the Lord. ||4||2||4||

lines.author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji (M5)
lines.gurmukhi: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.translit: todee mahalaa

lines.author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji (M5)
lines.gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਬਸਹੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਨੀਤ ॥
lines.translit: kripaa nidh basah ridai har neet
lines.en: O Lord, ocean of mercy, please abide forever in my heart.

lines.author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji (M5)
lines.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੀ ਬੁਧਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.translit: taisee budh karah paragaasaa laagai prabh sang preet
lines.en: Please awaken such understanding within me, that I may be in love with You, God. ||Pause||

lines.author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji (M5)
lines.gurmukhi: ਦਾਸ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਕੀ ਪਾਵਉ ਧੂਰਾ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇ ਲੇ ਲਾਵਉ ॥
lines.translit: daas tumaare kee paavau dhooraa masatak le le laavau
lines.en: Please, bless me with the dust of the feet of Your slaves; I touch it to my forehead.

lines.author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji (M5)
lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਪਤਿਤ ਤੇ ਹੋਤ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
lines.translit: mahaa patit te hot puneetaa har keeratan gun gaavau
lines.en: I was a great sinner, but I have been made pure, singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Glorious Praises. ||1||
